note: Imprudence is the vice opposed to prudence.
Injustice is the vice opposed to justice
Theft violates what is due to another concerning external possessions
Robbery violates what is due to another through the violent taking of possessions
Fraud violates the equality required in voluntary exchange
Usury as treated by Aquinas violates justice in lending and exchange
False testimony violates truthfulness while also committing injustice against another
Intemperance is the vice opposed to temperance
Lust is the vice opposed to temperance
Incontinence is the vice opposed to continence

ref: ST II-II Q142 Wrath is the vice opposed to meekness
ST II-II Q142 Cruelty is the vice opposed to clemency

note: Pride is the vice opposed to humility
Curiosity is the vice opposed to studiousness
